inside.description: The source is spatially contained within the target Region.

near.description: The source should be spatially close to the target. This is qualitative; exact distance is backend-defined.

far_from.description: The source should maintain clear spatial separation from the target. This is qualitative; exact distance is backend-defined.

along.description: The source is placed or distributed along the target Network.

direction_of.description: The source lies in the specified qualitative direction relative to the target.

semantic_notes: World IR expresses backend-independent, high-level world semantics, not exact coordinates, meshes, assets, collision shapes, or engine-specific placement instructions.
location is an optional absolute position relative to the world frame. relations[] expresses object-to-object spatial relations.
Region.location is optional in V1; a Region may instead be located entirely through relations such as direction_of another object.
inside, near, and along from V0 are represented only through relations[] in V1. Do not emit the legacy primitive fields inside/near/along.
buffer is removed in V1 because its semantics were ambiguous. Use far_from for qualitative separation; numeric spacing or distance is intentionally outside V1 for now.
Multiple relations on the same source are conjunctive: the backend should attempt to satisfy all of them together.
near and far_from are qualitative relations. Their exact geometric thresholds are backend-defined.
direction_of is object-relative. location remains world-relative.
Network from/to/via remain explicit topology fields and are not migrated into relations[].
count and density remain intrinsic Distribution attributes and are not relations.
Relation targets must reference existing object ids, and relation source/target primitive types should follow relation_types compatibility rules.
A symmetric relation such as near or far_from does not need to be duplicated on both objects; one declaration is sufficient semantic input.
Do not invent relation types, relation fields, primitive fields, or direction values absent from this specification.
If a user intent cannot be represented without inventing new relations or losing an essential semantic constraint, report an IR capability gap rather than silently approximating it.

migration_from_v0.location: Keep as an optional primitive field.
migration_from_v0.buffer: Remove; do not migrate automatically because V0 buffer semantics were ambiguous.
